description.value:
A modified version of the Kenshin. A favorite of Arasaka Counter-Intel Agents.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Smartgun Link, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. If there are not 2 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. While the user is in the Seriously or Mortally Wounded Wound State, this weapon overclocks itself. While overclocked, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6) when making an Aimed Shot, and when charging its Tech Rebuild, it remains charged until the end of a Turn in which it was fired.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Smartgun Link, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
